english_page_summary: This page discusses Islamic jurisprudence regarding the postures of prayer (Salah), specifically focusing on the obligatory nature (Farz) and tranquility (Tamaniyat) in ruku, sujood, raising the head, standing straight (qouma), and sitting (jalsa). It cites prophetic traditions (Hadith), including the famous narration of the Bedouin who prayed incorrectly and was instructed repeatedly by Prophet Muhammad to correct his posture and prayer.
